name: work-loop
summary: Hands an idle lane its next ticket from the ledger and keeps lanes fed on a schedule (tick): idle, rate-limit and hold guards, file or command delivery, starvation finding, heartbeat. An optional Stop hook (off by default) continues a registered lane with its next ticket, capped at 3.

env.HUBKIT_HOME: install root, default ~/.claude/hubkit (lanes.json and loop-feed.json live in $HUBKIT_HOME/state)
env.LEDGER_PATH: optional: read this ledger file instead of $HUBKIT_HOME/state/ledger.jsonl
env.HUBKIT_LANE: this chat's lane name; only the optional Stop arm (stop_arm.py) reads it

needs: the ledger pattern installed next to it
